purpose: Explicit owner decisions for warning conditions that are safe only while their scope constraints remain true.

decisions.match_message: Reverse proxy headers are not trusted
decisions.reason: The Control UI is verified loopback-only on 127.0.0.1 and no reverse proxy is configured. Adding a fictitious trusted proxy would not improve security.
decisions.decision_source: WebChat request to review and rectify the OpenClaw Doctor/security warnings.
review_triggers: gateway bind changes away from loopback
a reverse proxy, tunnel, Tailscale serve/funnel, or other remote exposure is enabled
Control UI access is delegated to another user

decisions.match_message: Potential multi-user setup detected (personal-assistant model warning)
decisions.reason: This remains a one-trusted-operator personal assistant. Telegram sender allowlists are populated from the paired owner record, group access remains allowlisted and mention-gated, and the gateway remains loopback-only. Full sandboxing would break the approved local workspace operating model without creating a real second trust boundary.
decisions.decision_source: WebChat request to review and rectify the OpenClaw Doctor/security warnings.
review_triggers: a second human receives gateway or channel access
Telegram group policy becomes open or the owner allowlist is removed
the gateway is exposed beyond loopback
untrusted workloads share this OS user or gateway
